notes: V2-10 final Muse-like evaluation set. 24 scenarios: 11 live V2 conversations on the Development DB, 4 paired V1 runs, 9 controlled (fake-model) tests. `mode` says how a scenario is evidenced. Wording metrics ignore the Dev fixture prefix [TEST].

scenarios.title: Forced generation failure
scenarios.evidence: planning-polish-session.vitest.test.ts: a failed generation says what happened and what to do next
scenarios.expected: No raw error; needs kept; actionable next step.

scenarios.title: Uncertain write blocks mutation, advice says last known
scenarios.evidence: planning-trip-structure + planning-guidance tests: guidance wording while a write is UNKNOWN
scenarios.expected: Advice allowed and labelled last known; next mutation blocked.

scenarios.title: Saved trip: proposal, awaiting confirmation, applied only after confirmed write
scenarios.expected: Three distinct states; success claimed only after the database confirmed.

scenarios.title: Pending missing-day question survives advice
scenarios.expected: Advice answered; the original edit resumes.

scenarios.title: Inconsistent nights clarification
